underlying_goal: Fix a dictionary data loading failure caused by browser API calls targeting localhost:8080 instead of the backend server, by implementing a proxy solution in Next.js
friction_detail: Initial rewrites proxy approach didn't work in Next.js standalone mode, requiring a pivot to API Route Handler approach which was interrupted before implementation.
brief_summary: User asked to implement a proxy fix for API calls failing in browser; the initial rewrites approach failed in standalone mode, and Claude was pivoting to an API Route Handler solution when the session was interrupted.
